curriculum.name: email_topic_report
curriculum.goal: Group all emails by their recipient and return a report of the topics for each recipient.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE email_topic_report()
$v0 = FIND EMAIL
$v1 = GROUP $v0 RECIPIENT
$v2 = REPORT $v1 TOPIC
RETURN $v2
END
